reports.title: Indivior Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Prior to the closing of the merger, Indivior is on track to achieve its previously communicated full year 2026 guidance as a standalone organization. That guidance assumed no material change in exchange rates for key currencies compared with 2025 average rates, notably USD/GBP and USD/EUR. Assuming the merger is completed November 2, 2026, we will operate as a combined company and the guidance will no longer apply.

Net Revenue | 1,295 million to $1,365 million
Total SUBLOCADE Net Revenue | 1,010 million to $1,050 million
Non-GAAP Operating Expenses* | 430 million to $450 million
Adjusted EBITDA* | 700 million to $740 million

* | We did not provide the forward-looking U.S. GAAP equivalents for certain forward-looking non-U.S. GAAP metrics as a result of the uncertainty and potential variability of reconciling items. Instead, the Company has relied upon the exception in Item 10(e)(1)(i)(B) of Regulation S-K to exclude such reconciliations, as the reconciliations of these non-U.S. GAAP guidance metrics to their corresponding U.S. GAAP equivalents are not available without unreasonable effort.
